lines: Of junctures they say this and Tantric not our opinion; which that in time chapter before juncture declared fourfold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sandhyānāmāhuretacca tāntrikīyaṃ na no matam yāsau kālādhikāre prāk sandhyā proktā catuṣṭayī
